hero.badge: No Account Needed • Join and Play Instantly
hero.title: Casual Battle Platform
hero.subtitle: Create a room with one click, send the link via Zalo or Messenger to friends for a showdown. No installation needed, no tedious registration.

lobby.gameCaroDesc: Classic 5-in-a-row rules on a 15x15 board. Real-time brain battle at its peak!
lobby.gameTicTacToeDesc: Classic 3x3 game, play fast win fast in 30 seconds.
lobby.createRoomDesc: You play as X (Go First). Get a link to share with friends.
lobby.joinRoomDesc: Enter the shared room code to play as O (Go Second).
lobby.featureRealtimeDesc: Send moves in milliseconds via Broadcast Channel, identify online opponents via Presence.
lobby.featureNoAuthDesc: No personal info stored, no passwords, only minimal room codes kept in DB.
lobby.featureShareDesc: Copy the link to send via messages so friends can open directly on phone or computer.
